sense: (of a thing) with a low temperature

pins.definition: Of an object, liquid, or body part: having a low temperature to the touch.
Having a low temperature; not warm or hot.
Having a low temperature, especially to the touch.

situation: A person on a hot summer day pulls a glass bottle of soda from an ice-filled metal cooler.
subject: the low temperature (the condensation)
brief: A close-up of a glass bottle being lifted from a metal cooler, with a thick, distinct layer of condensation frosting the glass surface. The subject is the white, icy bloom of mist covering the bottle, with distinct water droplets running down the glass against the warm, blurred background of a summer day.
